title: Quitting the horn after his grandfather's death; Professor Milton and learning by ear
summary: He put the trumpet away after his grandfather died, found it dusty, took lessons from Professor Milton but got by copying records and playing by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees
